# Audit 06 — Standardized Error Handling and Custom Exceptions

**Audit date:** 2026-09-29 · **Reviewed commit:** `0564118` (main) · **Deployed:** `v1.0.0` (`a00803b`).

Scope: exception boundaries, stable error codes, HTTP/CLI outcomes, safe user messages, logging, recoverable failures; swallowed errors, leaked private details and inconsistent contracts. Custom exceptions are recommended only where they add meaning.

| ERR-02 | Low | [ImportOpportunityEmailCommand.php](../../../app/Console/Commands/ImportOpportunityEmailCommand.php#L22-L73)                                                                           | `handle()` has no `Throwable` guard (one of two such commands — see ERR-05 for the health command). Parser failures are handled as quarantine inside the action, but an unexpected `QueryException` from **either** the pre-import `Workspace::query()->whereKey()->exists()` lookup (L38) **or** `ImportOpportunityEmail::execute()` (L52) propagates to the console handler, which prints the exception message (SQL with bindings such as the workspace ULID, message ID or content hash) and a stack trace. The other six commands map unexpected failures to a fixed code.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | Inconsistent CLI contract; connection/query metadata in terminal output during an outage.            | Wrap the whole body of `handle()` after argument parsing — covering the workspace lookup, file read and importer call — in `catch (Throwable)` → `error_code: import.operation_failed`, exit 1.                      |
| ERR-03 | Low | [DeadlineAwareImapProtocol.php](../../../app/Infrastructure/Email/DeadlineAwareImapProtocol.php#L143-L150)                                                                             | `throwIfDeadlineExhausted()` maps any stream `timed_out` to `mailbox.poll_budget_exhausted`, even when no poll budget was configured (falls back to the 30 s connection timeout). `CheckOpportunityMailboxCommand` never calls `usePollBudget`, so a stalled server during `mailbox-check` is reported as a budget exhaustion rather than `mailbox.connection_failed`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Misleading stable code in one path.                                                                  | Throw `ConnectionFailed` when `$this->deadline === null`.                                                                                                                                                            |

The other two mailbox commands guard.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Inconsistent; low-sensitivity leakage to the log.                                                    | Same guard as the poll command, covering configuration load and all health queries, returning `unhealthy` with a fixed code.                                                                                         |
| ERR-06 | Low | [bootstrap/app.php](../../../bootstrap/app.php#L29-L69); installed `Illuminate\Foundation\Exceptions\Handler` (`unauthenticated()`, `convertExceptionToArray()`, `prepareException()`) | **Added 2026-09-30.** The `{error_code, message, errors?}` JSON contract is implemented only for the cases the custom renderers cover: 422 on `/review/v1/*` (`review.validation_failed`), 409/413 (`review.stale_context`/`review.request_too_large`), `TriageException` (503/404 with `error_code`), and 403 from `EnsureReviewWorkspace`. Every other JSON error falls through to the framework default `{message}` **without** `error_code`: 401 (`{"message":"Unauthenticated."}`), 419 CSRF mismatch, 429 throttle, and 404 from `ModelNotFoundException`. For that 404 the framework copies the model exception's message, so the body is `No query results for model [App\Models\Opportunity] <requested-id>` — a fixed framework string containing the internal class name and the client-supplied ID, not private data. Tests assert only status codes for 401/404/429 (`ReviewAuthenticationTest`, `ReviewWorkspaceIsolationTest`), so this deviation from the Phase 4 sheet's "fixed safe messages" wording is untested, and the frontend keys its copy on `status`, not `error_code`, so behaviour is unaffected. | Contract inconsistency for API consumers; minor internal-name disclosure on 404. No security impact. | Either document the framework-default shapes as accepted, or extend the `HttpExceptionInterface` renderer to emit `error_code` + fixed message for 401/404/419/429 on `/review/v1/*` and add one assertion per code. |

## Optional architectural improvements (not defects)

| ID     | Location                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Observation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Smallest action (only if a non-HTTP caller is introduced)                                                                                                                                       |
| ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ERR-01 | [SaveOpportunityEnrichment.php](../../../app/Application/Review/SaveOpportunityEnrichment.php#L60-L91), [RecordOpportunityReview.php](../../../app/Application/Triage/RecordOpportunityReview.php#L94-L136) | Application-layer actions raise HTTP-specific exceptions (`abort(409)` → Symfony `HttpException`; Illuminate `ValidationException`) inside `DB::transaction`. `RecordOpportunityReview` throws `TriageException` for CLI callers and HTTP exceptions for dashboard callers depending on `$dashboardDetails`. The 409 mapping in [bootstrap/app.php](../../../bootstrap/app.php#L44-L57) works and every existing caller (controllers, CLI commands, tests) behaves correctly; this is a layering preference, not a demonstrated failure. Cross-referenced as EXP-01 in [03-expandability.md](03-expandability.md). | Introduce a domain `StaleReviewContextException` (`ShouldntReport`) and map it to `review.stale_context`/409 in `bootstrap/app.php`. Keep the framework `ValidationException` for field errors. |

## Accepted limitations (deliberate trade-offs)

| ID     | Location                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Observation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ERR-A1 | [PollOpportunityMailbox.php](../../../app/Application/Mailbox/PollOpportunityMailbox.php#L270-L274), [L479-L483](../../../app/Application/Mailbox/PollOpportunityMailbox.php#L479-L483), [PollOpportunityMailboxCommand.php](../../../app/Console/Commands/PollOpportunityMailboxCommand.php#L50-L52) | Any `Throwable` (including `TypeError`, `QueryException`) collapses to `mailbox.import_failed`, and the application logs nothing anywhere (grep: zero `Log::`/`report()` in `app/`). A programming error is indistinguishable from a transport failure. This is the documented privacy stance (no raw exception text may reach logs), but there is no _redacted_ diagnostic channel (e.g. exception class name only). Optional: log `get_class($e)` + stable code at `warning` level — class names carry no mailbox data.                                                                             |
| ERR-A2 | Cleanup `catch (Throwable) {}` blocks                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | [PollOpportunityMailbox.php](../../../app/Application/Mailbox/PollOpportunityMailbox.php#L281-L289), [L331-L334](../../../app/Application/Mailbox/PollOpportunityMailbox.php#L331-L334), [L393-L394](../../../app/Application/Mailbox/PollOpportunityMailbox.php#L393-L394), [WebklexImapMailboxClient.php](../../../app/Infrastructure/Email/WebklexImapMailboxClient.php#L307-L309), [CheckOpportunityMailboxCommand.php](../../../app/Console/Commands/CheckOpportunityMailboxCommand.php#L61-L64). ## Review limits

Exception _paths_ were traced by reading; only the HTTP boundary, the CLI health/summary commands and the Playwright error scenarios were executed. The default 401/404/419/429 JSON body shapes (ERR-06) were established from the installed framework handler source and the tests' status-only assertions, not by capturing production response bodies. Log content was inspected by pattern counts and redacted excerpts only.

**Reconciliation note (2026-09-30):** ERR-01 reclassified as optional, ERR-02 corrected, ERR-04 de-duplicated to REL-06, ERR-06 added. No finding is marked resolved.
